patch.value: Adopt the canonical SDK-certified complete-list reader

Replace the deprecated list-all subprocess with canonical list --all, exact-pin development to pm CLI/SDK 2026.8.21 while proving the 2026.8.20 behavior floor, and make the public SDK own shared complete-corpus certification before Gantt command or export consumes rows.

Production uses pm list --all with JSON, all statuses, full projection, strict-read, no-truncate, and both unbounded controls; public SDK inspection and certification own shared policy while narrow supplemental checks reject the verified pm-cli issue 1078 gaps; malformed, bounded, omitted, unreadable, contradictory, duplicate-ID, and bare-array outputs fail closed; raw manifest compatibility is proven at minimum 2026.8.20 and exact development 2026.8.21; mandatory packed npm/npx current, Bun/bunx current, and npm/npx minimum acceptance exercises real Gantt command and export with no alias diagnostic; README, tests, changelog, release workflow, package PM evidence, CI, review, privacy, and independent coverage blockers are recorded honestly; no merge or publication occurs while pm-gantt-chart-8mkl or pm-gantt-chart-2u8i is open
Installed pm CLI and SDK 2026.8.21 on clean pm-gantt-chart main 2026.8.18

Run pm gantt from a packed extension or inspect fetchItems in index.ts; production still sends deprecated list-all and hand-maintains the complete-list envelope policy against a 2026.8.17 development SDK.

Every Gantt command and exporter reads the complete tracker through canonical strict full unbounded argv, current public SDK certification, and narrow fail-closed supplements for verified SDK gaps, without alias diagnostics.

Baseline release:check passes 172 tests and exact configured index.ts coverage, but runtime argv and operator text still use list-all, development is pinned to 2026.8.17, changelog reads are bounded, and no packed current/minimum-host acceptance exists.
Deprecated alias diagnostics pollute agent stderr; duplicated package-owned receipt logic can drift from the host SDK and permit a partial schedule to be presented as complete.
